# The technician API — the contract the phone app is built on

`CR-168-BRC10` §F · `BR-WRK-059`–`063` · built `2.509.0` · lane FIELD-FIX

**Why it exists.** PO, 2026-10-04: *"you should create apis for techncian app and use those apis wth payload to complete the jobs"*. Until a native app exists, technician work is done by calling this API as the technician (`10-scripts/technician_api_walk.py`); the office then accepts through its own route. The office never completes a job (ruling 18).

**Where the shape is defined.** Every route below is in `06-backend/openapi/schema.json` (generated by `manage.py spectacular`, never hand-edited). The examples at the end of this file are captured from a PostgreSQL 16 server by the walk, never typed (`10-scripts/technician_api_contract_examples.py`).

**Base path.** `/api/{tenant}/…`. Every route is scoped to the CALLER's own technician: another technician's job answers **404**, the same as a job that does not exist.

## The rules the API keeps

| Rule | What it means for a client |
|---|---|
| `BR-WRK-059` shared device | Ask `POST /work/mobile/capture-token` right after sign-in; stamp that token on every item captured while this technician is signed in. The server writes each item as the token's technician, whoever's session sends it. |
| `BR-WRK-060` unsent work | Sign-out never blocks and never deletes. Items captured under a token keep going under that token after sign-out, even while someone else is signed in. |
| `BR-WRK-061` location | Every item and the close carry `location: {lat, lng, accuracy_m, fix_at}`. A close is never refused for location; a fix wider than the tenant's setting (default 50 m) shows *Location not precise* to the office. |
| `BR-WRK-062` photographs | Declare a photo in the data page (`kind: "photo"`, your own `photo_id`, its `sha256`, the task or reading). The answer carries its `upload_url`. Upload the bytes there whenever you have a signal. Accept waits while a REQUIRED photo is still uploading. |
| `BR-WRK-063` nothing dropped | Remove an item from the device ONLY when its key is in the response's `acknowledged`. An item the server cannot apply is stored and flagged *Needs review* and is still acknowledged. Server → phone is the paged change feed. |
| `BR-WRK-042` offline | Items keep their `captured_at` (the handset's time). Re-sending a page adds nothing. One bad item never sinks the page. Pages are at most **200** items. |
| `BR-WRK-047` (as superseded) | Compress each photo to 70–100 KB. A photo is never refused for size; the server shrinks anything over 100 KB. A file that is not an image is refused. |

## The routes, in the order a job is done

| # | Route | Payload | Answer | Refusals (message key) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `POST /auth/session` | `{email, password, surface: "mobile"}` | `201`, the session cookie | `identity` sign-in refusals; a web-only login on `mobile` and the reverse are named |
| 2 | `POST /work/mobile/capture-token` | `{device_label?}` | `{capture_token, technician, max_age_seconds}` | 404 for a login with no technician profile |
| 3 | `GET /work/mobile/changes?cursor=&page_size=` | — | `{changes: [{change: "upsert", order_id, at, job} \| {change: "removed", order_id, at}], count, next_cursor, has_more}` | `work.mobile.cursor_malformed` (422) |
| 4 | `GET /work/mobile/jobs/{id}` | — | the whole job (safety, tasks, readings, materials, help, customer) | 404 another's job |
| 5 | `GET /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/readings?page=&page_size=` | — | `{count, page, pages, next, previous, results}` | 404 |
| 6 | `POST /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/accept` | `{}` | `{technician_acceptance: {state: "accepted", at}}` (idempotent) | `work.mobile.job_already_declined` (409) · `work.mobile.job_finished` (409) |
| 6b | `POST /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/decline` | `{reason}` | `{technician_acceptance: {state: "declined", at, reason}}` | `work.mobile.decline_reason_required` (422) · `work.mobile.job_already_accepted` (409) |
| 7 | `POST /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/acts` | `{act: "depart" \| "arrive"}` | the dispatch row (`dispatch_state`) | `work.mobile.act_not_a_field_act` (422) · `work.mobile.job_already_declined` |
| 8 | `POST /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/sync` | `{items: [{key, kind, seq, captured_at, capture_token, location, payload}]}` ≤ 200 | `{accepted, duplicate, held_for_review, refused, acknowledged: [keys], items: [{key, kind, result, ack, detail}]}` | per item, see below |
| 9 | `PUT /work/mobile/photos/{photo_id}` | the image bytes (`Content-Type: image/jpeg`) or multipart `file` | `{photo_id, upload_url, state, attachment_id, duplicate}` | `work.photo.hash_mismatch` (409, send again) · `work.attachment.not_an_image` (422) |
| 9b | `GET /work/mobile/photos/{photo_id}` | — | `{state: pending \| staged \| landed}` — what a resumed upload asks | 404 |
| 10 | `POST /work-orders/{id}/signature` | multipart `printed_name`, `file` (or `refused`, `decline_reason`, `door_hanger_attachment_id`), `capture_token` | the signature row | `work.signature.*` |
| 11 | `POST /work/mobile/jobs/{id}/sync` with `kind: "close"` | `{outcome}` + `location` | the order `completed`, `close_location` on it | the safety lock only (`work.order.finish_safety_first`, not acknowledged) |
| — | `GET /work/mobile/reconciliation` | — | what the server holds of my captures, by kind; photos declared vs landed | — |
| — | `POST` / `DELETE /work/mobile/devices` | `{token, platform?}` | register (moves the token to me) / release at sign-out | `work.mobile.device_token_required` |
| office | `GET /work-orders/{id}` | — | `photos_uploading`, `closed.location.precise` | — |
| office | `POST /work-orders/{id}/accept` | `{}` | accepted | `work.order.photos_uploading` (409, `count`) · `metering.work_order_not_completed` · `metering.event_reads.errors_refuse` (`DEF-WRK-9642`) |
| office | `GET /work/photo-links/stale` | — | links empty after 24 hours, paged — listed, never deleted | — |

### Sync item kinds (`payload`)

| `kind` | `payload` |
|---|---|
| `safety_tick` | `{safety_id}` |
| `task_tick` | `{task_id}` |
| `reading` | `{reading_id, value, unit}`, or `{reading_id, value_text}` for a text reading, or `{reading_id, value: null, unable_to_read: true, unable_reason?}` for *Unable to read* — any kind, never refused, flagged for the office (`DEF-WRK-10601`). The phone's exact three shapes are `field-app/tests/sync/support/jobReadingShapes.json`, held by a test on each side |
| `material` | `{material_id, used_qty}` |
| `photo` | `{photo_id (your uuid), sha256 (hex), task_id \| reading_id}` → `detail.upload_url` |
| `attachment` | `{idempotency_key}` — confirms a photo sent through `POST /work-orders/{id}/attachments` |
| `signature` | as the signature route, without the image |
| `close` | `{outcome: passed \| partly_done \| failed \| waiting_on_someone_else, field_data?}` |

### Per-item results

| `result` | `ack` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `accepted` | yes | applied |
| `duplicate` | yes | the server already has this key (a photo answers the SAME link) |
| `held_for_review` | yes | stored as received and flagged for the office (`detail.needs_review` names why: `work.mobile.accept_the_job_first`, `work.mobile.not_your_job`, `work.sync.job_already_closed`, `work.sync.job_already_accepted`, `work.sync.job_cancelled`, `work.sync.unknown_item_kind`, `work.mobile.capture_token_expired`, a validation key such as `work.reading.unit_required`) |
| `refused` | **no** — keep it | only an unverifiable `capture_token` (`work.mobile.capture_token_invalid`) and the safety lock (`work.order.finish_safety_first`) |

## The field app as a client (`2.510.0`, lane FIELD-2)

`07-frontend/src/features/work/mobile` is built on this contract, and is the reference client:

| Concern | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | `MobileApp.tsx` · `offlineStore.ts` | `POST /work/mobile/capture-token` at sign-in; the token is kept per login and stamped on every item AT CAPTURE. Day and bundles are kept per login. Sign-out forgets who is signed in and deletes nothing. |
| Capture | `capture.ts` | One door: key, `captured_at`, `capture_token`, `location`, then the outbox, then a send if there is a signal. |
| Outbox | `mobileEndpoints.ts` (`flushOutbox`) | Per job, pages of ≤ 200 in capture order; an item is removed only when its key is in `acknowledged`; then each photo's bytes `PUT` to `/work/mobile/photos/{photo_id}`, removed only on a 200. On opening, on `online`, and every 30 s. |
| Change feed | `mobileEndpoints.ts` (`syncChanges`) | `GET /work/mobile/changes` from a cursor kept per technician; `upsert` refreshes that job's bundle, `removed` forgets it. |
| Location | `location.ts` | `watchPosition` from the moment the job opens; best = smallest `accuracy_m`. |
| Acceptance | `JobPage.tsx` | *Accept job* (`POST …/accept`) when the bundle's `technician_acceptance.state` is `pending` (added to `GET /work/mobile/jobs/{id}` in `2.510.0`). |

**The office is told** (notifications kind `field_work`, in-app, BR-NOT-021): a close (with the count of required photos still uploading), the last required photo of a closed job landing, and items held for review (one message per page). The bell renders `notifications.fieldWork.*` in the clerk's language.
